premises.text: Email is a fundamental communication tool for businesses that often leads to inefficiencies.
premises.evidence_span: the email problem is so big it's just bugged us for years and years

premises.text: Making email more productive can enhance collaboration and reduce wasted time.
premises.evidence_span: we want to do is make email more productive, so it wastes less time in it, more collaborative, and more social

premises.text: A loop is a smart mailing list that enhances email functionality.
premises.evidence_span: The loop is a smart mailing list, easy to search, easy to share, easy to create

premises.text: Users can create loops easily via email without needing IT support.
premises.evidence_span: There was no IT help desk request. No one had to download anything. No one had to learn anything because it's just email

premises.text: Loops can be followed and searched by users, providing easy access to relevant information.
premises.evidence_span: I can join the loop, and I'll go to the web interface... I can search inside of threads. I can search inside of attachments

premises.text: Email lists have intrinsic virality, which can enhance user adoption.
premises.evidence_span: email lists are just intrinsically viral, which is part of what got us interested in the idea in the first place

premises.text: Customization and integration features can drive revenue through a freemium model.
premises.evidence_span: customers have told us they'll pay for customization. They can use their own logo. They can use their own email address

premises.text: The application does not require users to change their behavior, making it easier to adopt.
premises.evidence_span: we don't ask for behavior changes because it's just email. People know how to use email

value.text: Email can be made more effective and collaborative in the workplace.
value.evidence_span: we're hoping that along the way we can make email cool again, at least in the workplace

notes: Private beta status and distribution methods excluded as traction.
